summary: Karyopharm Therapeutics filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing that on October 13, 2026, the parties to its September 10, 2026 Forbearance Agreement and Limited Waiver to Indentures extended the Forbearance Period end date from 11:59 p.m. Eastern on October 15, 2026 to 11:59 p.m. Eastern on October 22, 2026. This is the second short extension while the company remains in discussions with noteholders. No price, stake, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. Watch for expiration risk and potential restructuring or exchange offer.
